critical_code_review_comments: RideTrackingPage.js still ~887 lines with the legacy non-pending/non-cancelled render block at L635+ (containing duplicated data-testids: ride-tracking-page, ride-done-btn). Now that pending AND cancelled both early-return, the only path that reaches L635 is for active rides (driver_assigned/in_progress/completed). Worth cleaning up: (a) delete dead legacy pending/cancelled JSX, (b) split into RideWaitingScreen.jsx + RideCancelledScreen.jsx + RideActiveScreen.jsx for maintainability.

Fix uses inline style={{backgroundColor:'#0B1426'}} which is the recommended approach. However, root cause (.mobile-container { background:#ffffff } in /app/frontend/src/index.css L173 silently winning over Tailwind utilities) still exists and will bite future devs. Recommend removing the global white background from .mobile-container and making it opt-in via a separate class .mobile-container-light.
